mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the rise in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, it signals a disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: disinflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent market performance.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the decrease in PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent easing actions by the Fed.
